dedupe_keys.name: 統計いしかき 通信およひ運輸 telecommunications series on bodik odcs

description: 統計いしがき】通信および運輸 [telecommunications] (series on BODIK ODCS) is a series of datasets listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 石垣市. 8-1. 電話施設の概況 8-2. 道路運送事業者数及び車両数 8-3. 自動車保有数 8-4. 入港船舶数 8-5. 船舶入港等状況（離島 バージを含む） 8-6. 石垣港の貨物取扱量の推移 8-7. 石垣港の品種別貨物取扱量 8-8. 輸出入における年別総額表 8-9. 輸入品別表 8-10. 輸出品別表 8-11. 輸出入国別表 8... Coverage: 石垣市. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 石垣市. Its tags are 令和6年度統計いしがき. It offers 15 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-05-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
